title: Authentication API database connection pool exhaustion
root_cause: A database connection leak introduced during deployment caused the connection pool to become exhausted.
resolution: Rolled back the affected deployment and verified that database connections and API error rates returned to normal.
lessons_learned: Monitor active database connections and test connection disposal before production deployments.

title: Payment API latency caused by database performance degradation
root_cause: A missing database index caused expensive queries under high transaction volume.
resolution: Added the appropriate database index and monitored query performance.
lessons_learned: Review query execution plans and performance before deployment.

title: Authentication failures caused by expired signing certificate
resolution: Renewed the certificate and verified successful authentication.
lessons_learned: Implement certificate expiration alerts and automated renewal checks.

title: Member API errors following configuration deployment
root_cause: A required configuration property was missing from the deployment environment.
resolution: Restored the missing configuration and redeployed the service.
lessons_learned: Validate environment configurations before releasing application updates.
